claims.title: Actual Type-I paired-contraction polynomials and factorial block lattices
claims.statement: The actual SSZ generators, coarse degrees, retained predicates, scalar factorial multiplier, rational-span intersection and block-orthogonal form are specified without replacing the source family.

claims.title: Finite full lattices, optimal primitive-test rank and tensor near-diagonal rank
claims.statement: The source block lattices are finite free and full with integral pairing; Smith factors exactly determine maximal good saturated rank. A diagonal pairing modulo w^c gives the stated tests whenever each diagonal valuation is below c/2.

claims.title: Exact gamma polynomial degree and leading form by harmonic contraction and Taylor evaluation
claims.statement: For the actual freeze substitution and tiePhi normalization, degree is at most S+o-max(e,e'), and the equal-order leading coefficient is e! binom(z+e,e) times the initial Fock pairing divided by o!S!product d_i!.

claims.title: Integral binomial coefficients by multinomial carries and finite differences
claims.statement: Integral coefficients hold after the explicit exponent (2r+1)floor log_p(S+o+r)+(N+2)(r-1)floor log_p(3S), with S=0 treated separately. This implies the source GamInt exponent 10(N+3)r^2(floor log_p(S+o+r)+1).

claims.title: Complete polynomial-matrix average on a p-adic-unit progression
claims.statement: Integral binomial discs, a determinant-coefficient Smith bound, Gauss norm root factorization and residue-class counting give average bad Smith count <= n[d/Y+(L+dh/Y)/E].

claims.title: Actual one-tie Gram average with determinant and rounding constants explicit
claims.statement: For the actual matrix p^ceil(kappa) Gamma, average bad count is at most n[2S/Y+(ceil(kappa)+kappa4+3ell+2Sell/Y)/E]. Equal-order initial Gram blocks supply the determinant leading coefficient. The source's restricted graded Gram input remains explicit.

claims.title: Dimension-weighted transfer by simultaneous degree translations
claims.statement: The injective translate map and a product of scalar harmonic-dimension sums convert KeyIneq into mean kF<=2 mean kx under the source volume and density hypotheses.

claims.title: Final kappa translation and boundary loss
claims.statement: The actual lower-shift/boundary term, twice upper-shift term and 12Nkc/b' give mean kText<=6(CA+Cs)NN1/Y+2/Y, hence the source constant 6(CA+Cs)+8.

claims.statement: Restricted graded Gram, simultaneous partner compatibility, weighted digit-class estimates, actual paired edge lifts, harmonic-model/cleaning passage and uniform numerical supply remain separate obligations.
